## What's on this screen

| Element | What it is | Shows / does | Rules | On Linux |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Rows | list | ApplicationSummary: icon, name, slug, visibility, review_status |  | GtkListBox .boxed-list |
| Register app | primary-button | → APL-02 | applications.manage, or anyone with a verified email (self-service, flag `app_registration_self_service`); unverified → disabled with "Verify your email to register apps" | GtkButton .suggested-action .pill |

## Good to know

- **Loading, empty and error states:** Loading: skeleton after 300 ms; Error: inline with Retry; codes per COPY-AND-STATES

## For developers

Loads: `GET /applications?owned=true (staff: all, filter review_status)`

Every call sends `Substratal-Version: 1` to `https://api.substratalapps.com` (no `/v1` in the path). See [API versioning]({{ '/api/versioning/' | relative_url }}) and the [API reference]({{ '/api/reference/' | relative_url }}).
